text: 【外国企业对特定挤出涂层磁线提起337调查申请】据中国贸易救济信息网消息，2026年9月29日，美国Essex Solutions Inc.、美国Essex Solutions USA LLC根据《美国1930年关税法》第337节规定向美国国际贸易委员会提出申请，主张对美出口、在美进口及销售的特定挤出涂层磁线违反了美国337条款。
text_en: [Foreign companies file Section 337 investigation application over certain extrusion-coated magnet wire] According to the China Trade Remedy Information Network, on September 29, 2026, US-based Essex Solutions Inc. and Essex Solutions USA LLC filed an application with the US International Trade Commission under Section 337 of the US Tariff Act of 1930, alleging that certain extrusion-coated magnet wire exported to, imported into, and sold in the United States violates US Section 337.
